The '''Jexeria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Jexerian cannon]] weapon.<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Jexerian cannon]]|system=Jexeria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Jexeria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square T-8.<ref name="TEA" />
